paragraphs: R' Menashia bar Azzat — Sanhedrin 19a; some read עות or אילה.[^1][^2]

notes.text: וי״ג is read as ויש גורסין, “some read,” not the numeral 13. Hyman gives עות or אילה as alternatives to עזת; their Hebrew is retained rather than inventing “Azzot.” Earlier machine OCR had עות in the heading and אילת in the alternative.
יט. gives Sanhedrin 19a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The abbreviated title remains R'.
